name: NDatabase
tagline: Embedded .NET object database ported from NeoDatis ODB: store plain C# objects in one file. Abandoned.
description: NDatabase was an embedded object database for .NET by Polish developer Jacek Spólnik, derived from the NeoDatis ODB code base. It persisted ordinary C# objects without mapping files, attributes or base classes, offered ACID transactions with automatic recovery on the next open, indexes and type-safe queries, and kept everything in a single database file opened through OdbFactory. Releases ran on CodePlex and NuGet from 2012 to 3.8.0 in May 2013; CodePlex has shut down and the old ndatabase.net domain now serves unrelated content, though the NuGet packages remain. For new .NET work, LiteDB or SQLite with an ORM are the practical choices.
statusNote: Last release 3.8.0 (May 2013); CodePlex is gone and ndatabase.net now hosts unrelated content. Use LiteDB or SQLite.
strengths: Persists plain C# objects with no mapping or attributes
ACID transactions with automatic recovery on restart
weaknesses: Abandoned since 2013 and targets old .NET Framework versions
Original site and CodePlex source hosting are gone
useCases: Maintaining old .NET desktop apps that already use it
Studying a compact embedded object-store design in C#
